item: SQLCipher engine legs run their ten files on the runner CPUs (pytest-xdist, the suite's fixed placement)
summary: Follow-on to #1816: the floor and newest engine legs spent 7 to 8 of their 8 minutes in one pytest process; -n auto --dist loadfile runs the same files, each whole on one worker. Measured locally on 4 cores: 2 min 11 s for the ten files.
